title: modern-Tailwind v4 cohesion
summary: The bulk of the TW1 (@theme inline), TW2 (oklch ramps), and most TW4/TW5/TW6 SFC lifts landed in the AV.W15 commit (8036370). W16 closed the remaining cohesion gaps + completed the @theme-inline migration + authored the born-RED-then-green idiom gate.

radius_single_source.finding: the radius scale was DOUBLE-declared — tokens.css §4 (--radius … --radius-tooltip) AND theme.css (the primitives + the @theme inline aliases) — the exact doubled override surface TW1 targets, the one family the W15 migration missed.
radius_single_source.fix: excised the tokens.css §4 radius twin; theme.css is now the single source. The radius PRIMITIVES + the SEMANTIC ALIASES both live in a LEADING plain @theme block (NOT @theme inline).
radius_single_source.why_plain_not_inline: @theme inline substitutes the resolved VALUE into the utility, so two aliases resolving to the same primitive (--radius-card + --radius-dialog both → var(--radius-2xl); --radius-input + --radius-button both → var(--radius)) collapse to an identical value and Tailwind v4 DROPS one rounded-* utility when both candidates are scanned from source. This was a latent W15 regression: rounded-card (used 75×) + rounded-input silently failed to mint once a sibling-valued alias (rounded-dialog, in confirm-dialog/dialog-native) was scanned. Plain @theme mints each alias's own --radius-* var so value-identical siblings never collide.

oklch_ramps.state: landed at W15, verified at W16
oklch_ramps.dark_mirrors: light-dark() pairs convert in lockstep (the .dark{} block + the inline light-dark() mirrors)

B_sfc_lifts.state: TW4/TW5/TW6 SFC lifts landed at W15; W16 closed the one stray site

stray_lift.note: the --ease-standard bridge exists (theme.css); this was the lone registered-namespace wrap the W15 sweep left. Caught by gate assert (b).

dock.variants: @container dock (max-width: 29.9375rem) + (min-width: 30rem) and (max-width: 44.9375rem) on the audacious-density label

typography.swap: @media (min-width: 640px) → @container (min-width: 40rem) on .text-pane-title (unnamed container query → nearest pane ancestor)

asserts.a_no_theme_fn: zero theme(colors.…) function sites under src/ (0 hits)
asserts.b_no_registered_wrap: no <util>-[var(--z|radius|duration|ease-…)] SFC wrap where the bridge mints the named utility (0 hits, 0 allowlisted)
asserts.c_container_context: dock.css + instrument-chassis.css carry a @container CONTEXT and read @container size variants (both ok)
asserts.d_theme_completeness: duration(8/10 bridged, 2 holdout), ease-spring(10/11 bridged, 1 holdout), glass-blur(6/6), named-shadow(16 bridges, 0 dangling)

duration: --duration-shimmer-fast — shimmer-composite tempo, consumed inside --animate-shimmer*, no standalone utility
ease_spring: --spring-dock — dock FLIP choreography constant, raw var() inside the dock motion recipes
holdouts.named_shadow: bridge-INTEGRITY check (every theme.css --shadow-* bridge resolves to an existing tokens.css token) rather than forward completeness — the -shadow namespace is mixed (rungs + recipe internals), a forward regex over-matches

sanctioned_sites_off_the_flag_list: compound transition-[…] property lists (TabsIndicator, Toast, CarouselDots, Toggle, ConfiguratorLayer, StackedIconGroup) — property lists, not var wraps
slider [--slider-track-height:…] DECLARATIONS (the declare-vs-consume distinction; the : form is never matched by the consume-wrap regex)
choreography constants scale-[var(--scale-press)] / scale-[var(--scale-hover)] (scale namespace, no --scale-* bridge)
gate.born_red_then_green: verified by bite-tests: injecting a theme() call, a z-[var(--z-dock)] wrap, a dropped @container context, or an un-bridged duration row each reddens; reverting greens.

gates_reconciled.proof:theme: the cssAssertions encoded the PRE-inline expectation (border-radius: var(--radius-card), font-size: var(--text-display-1), …). The W15 @theme inline migration had left this gate RED (substitution emits the tokens.css source token, not the namespace var). W16 updated the assertions to the @theme-inline substituted values (var(--type-display-1), var(--gold), var(--z-dock), …) AND the radius restructure fixed the rounded-card MISSING-utility failure. Now green.
